motion.$description: Motion (port-manifest §8.5). All three durations collapse to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion; that override is emitted into the generated CSS from the reducedMotion extension below, so the accessibility rule lives with the token rather than in a stylesheet someone can forget to update.

dur.$description: Default transition: row collapse, opacity, layout.

ease.$description: The single easing curve. Everything uses it.
